summary: The Chicago Bears beat the Minnesota Vikings 12-10 on Monday Night Football (Nov. 27, 2023) when Cairo Santos kicked a 30-yard field goal with 10 seconds left. Vikings quarterback Joshua Dobbs threw four interceptions, but the Bears scored only three points off them and didn't score a touchdown. Justin Fields fumbled twice but delivered a 36-yard completion to D.J. Moore on 3rd & 10 to set up the winning kick. The loss dropped Minnesota to 6-6 and the No. 7 NFC seed.
one_line: Bears edge Vikings 12-10 on a late Cairo Santos field goal despite Joshua Dobbs throwing four interceptions on Monday Night Football.
key_facts: The Bears beat the Vikings 12-10 on Monday Night Football on Nov. 27, 2023, at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis.
Joshua Dobbs threw four interceptions for the Vikings, but the Bears scored only three points off them.
Cairo Santos kicked the game-winning 30-yard field goal with 10 seconds remaining, after missing a 48-yarder earlier and hitting a 55-yarder.
On 3rd & 10 outside field goal range, Justin Fields hit D.J. Moore for a 36-yard gain to set up the winning kick.
Fields fumbled twice; the first was turned into the game's only touchdown, a Dobbs pass to T.J. Hockenson that gave Minnesota a 10-9 lead.
The Bears' defense sacked Dobbs only twice but pressured him heavily; interceptions came from Jaylon Johnson, Jaquan Brisker, T.J. Edwards and Kyler Gordon.
The win was Chicago's first over an NFC North opponent since 2021; the Bears improved to 4-8.
Minnesota fell to 6-6 and the No. 7 seed in the NFC, with the Packers, Rams and Saints a half-game behind.
Justin Jefferson was officially out, held out until the Vikings return from their Week 14 bye.
The Bears hold the No. 1 and No. 4 picks in the 2024 NFL Draft entering the game; the No. 1 pick came via the Panthers' poor season.
The game-time temperature was 15 degrees in Minnesota (feels like 2), with the roof closed at U.S. Bank Stadium.
Before this game, the Bears hadn't beaten the Vikings since 2020, with Minnesota 6-1 against Chicago over the previous four seasons.
